title: 第408章 这孩子我也不稀罕了，你爱要不要！
slug: 离婚当天前夫小叔连夜抢我领证
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

厉延霏回到家，吃了药，换了身干净的衣裳，就躺在床上休息。

刘母从外面打牌回来，嘴里哼着歌，手里提着菜，正要去厨房做饭，瞟见了躺在床上的厉延霏，吓了一跳。

平时中午厉延霏都是不回来吃饭的。

“你在家挺尸呢？声也不出，吓我一大跳。”

刘母轻拍着胸脯，把菜往桌子上一丢，“今天倒是金贵，班也不上，活也不干，就瘫在床上享清福？”

厉延霏实在难受，不想理她，翻了个身，继续睡。

刘母火气更盛，走到床头去扒拉她：“问你话呢？好好的班不上，回来躺着当千金小姐啊？我们刘家可养不起闲人。”

“别碰我！我见红了！”

厉延霏怕她碰到自己的肚子，连忙甩开她的手。

“呵，本事不大，身子倒金贵。”

刘母冷笑一声，“怀个孩子都能见红，你还能干啥？行了，不上班就不上班吧，在家伺候我们也一样。赶紧起来，把饭做了，那盆衣服也洗了，晾出去。”

厉延霏咬着牙：“你听不懂吗？我说我见红了，医生说要卧床休息。”

刘母翻了个白眼：“医生吓唬两句你就当真？哪个女人不生孩子？就你矫情。”

说着又伸手去拽她，“赶紧起来，别跟我装死。”

厉延霏挣扎着：“我怀得可是你的孙子，你就不怕你孙子没了吗？”

“没了就没了，就你这娇滴滴的德行，能生出什么好种来？”

刘母满不在乎，一个孩子而已，只要她想，多的是女人给她儿子生。

厉延霏硬是被刘母拖下了床，膝盖磕到桌角到，疼得她眼泪差点掉出来。

“滚开！”

她猛地挣开刘母的手，用力推了一把。

刘母没站稳，连退几步，后背撞上门板。

恰巧这时，刘启强推门进来，正好看见母亲被推得撞在门上的这一幕。

他脸色一沉，快步走过去扶住刘母，转头瞪着厉延霏：“厉延霏，你干什么？！”

刘母本来没多疼，但见到儿子回来，立马挤出两滴眼泪。

“儿子，你看看你媳妇！大白天不去上班，在家挺尸就算了，饭不做、衣裳也不洗，我就说了她两句，她就敢推我！这是要造反啊？这还没过门几天就这样，往后还不得骑到我头上来拉屎拉尿！”

厉延霏半点不示弱：“你是瘫了还是残了？要我一个孕妇来伺候，我都说了我不舒服……”

“啪！”

Page (1/3)

Li Yanfei returned home, took medicine, changed into clean clothes, and lay on the bed to rest.

Liu's mother came back from playing cards outside, humming a song and holding dishes in her hands. She was about to go to the kitchen to cook when she saw Li Yanfei lying on the bed and was startled.

Li Yanfei usually doesn't come back for lunch at noon.

"Are you holding up the body at home? You didn't say anything. It scared me."

Mother Liu patted her chest lightly and threw the dishes on the table, "Today is a very expensive day. You don't have to go to class or do any work, so you just slump in bed and enjoy the happiness?"

Li Yanfei felt really uncomfortable and didn't want to pay attention to her. She turned over and continued to sleep.

Liu's mother became even more angry and walked to the bedside to pull her away: "What are you asking? Why don't you go back to work and become a wealthy lady? Our Liu family can't afford to raise idle people."

"Don't touch me! I'm blushing!"

Li Yanfei was afraid that she would touch his belly, so he quickly shook her hand away.

"Oh, I don't have much ability, but my body is worth a lot of money."

Mother Liu sneered, "You are pregnant with a child, so what else can you do? Okay, don't go to work if you don't want to go to work, and the same goes for serving us at home. Get up quickly, cook the meal, wash the basin of clothes, and hang them out to dry."

Li Yanfei gritted his teeth: "Don't you understand? I said I saw redness, and the doctor said I need to stay in bed."

Mother Liu rolled her eyes: "Do you take the doctor's scare words seriously? Which woman doesn't have children? You're just being pretentious."

Then he stretched out his hand to pull her, "Get up quickly, don't pretend to be dead with me."

Li Yanfei struggled: "I am pregnant with your grandson, aren't you afraid that your grandson will be gone?"

"If it's gone, it's gone. With your delicate virtues, what kind of good seeds can you produce?"

Mother Liu didn't care, it was just one child. As long as she wanted, there would be many women to give birth to her son.

Li Yanfei was dragged out of bed by Liu's mother, and her knee hit the corner of the table, which was so painful that she almost burst into tears.

"Get away!"

She suddenly broke away from Mother Liu's hand and pushed hard.

Mother Liu didn't stand firm, took a few steps back, and hit the door panel with her back.

At this moment, Liu Qiqiang pushed the door open and saw his mother being pushed against the door.

His face darkened, he quickly walked over to support Liu's mother, turned to glare at Li Yanfei: "Li Yanfei, what are you doing?!"

Liu's mother didn't feel much pain at first, but when she saw her son coming back, she immediately squeezed out a few tears.

"Son, look at your wife! She doesn't go to work in broad daylight and just stays at home. She doesn't cook or wash her clothes. I just said a few words to her and she dared to push me! Is she trying to rebel? She's been like this for just a few days, and she won't be allowed to sit on my head and poop or pee!"

Li Yanfei didn't show any weakness at all: "Are you paralyzed or disabled? You want me, a pregnant woman, to take care of you. I already told you that I don't feel well..."

"Crack!"
